subs.name: 氨
subs.note: 先通氨使溶液呈碱性，利于吸收 CO₂。
subs.noteEn: Passed first to alkalinize the brine, aiding CO₂ absorption.

subs.name: 碳酸氢钠
subs.note: 因溶解度较小而析出，是锻烧得纯碱的中间体。
subs.noteEn: Precipitates as the least soluble; the intermediate calcined to soda ash.

subs.name: 氯化铵
subs.note: 作氮肥析出，提高原料利用率。
subs.noteEn: Crystallized out as nitrogen fertilizer, raising salt utilization.

subs.name: 碳酸钠（纯碱）
subs.note: 最终产品，由 NaHCO₃ 受热分解得到。
subs.noteEn: Final product, from thermal decomposition of NaHCO₃.

oneLiner: 向饱和氨盐水中通 CO₂，析出碳酸氢钠再锻烧得纯碱。
oneLinerEn: Pass CO₂ into ammoniated brine; precipitated NaHCO₃ is calcined to soda ash.
detail: 侯德榜改进索尔维制碱法，使 NH₄Cl 作化肥析出，食盐利用率高。先通氨再通 CO₂，因 NaHCO₃ 溶解度较小而析出。
detailEn: Hou Debang improved the Solvay process, crystallizing NH₄Cl as fertilizer with high salt utilization. Ammonia is passed first, then CO₂; NaHCO₃ precipitates as the least soluble.

subs.name: 硬脂酸钠
subs.note: 肥㚬的主要成分，具去污能力。
subs.noteEn: The main soap component; has cleansing power.

subs.name: 丙三醇（甘油）
subs.noteEn: By-product; used as a skin moisturizer.

oneLiner: 油脂在氢氧化钠溶液中水解，生成高级脂肪酸钠和甘油。
oneLinerEn: Fats hydrolyze in NaOH solution into soap (fatty sodium salts) and glycerol.
detail: 硬脂酸甘油酯与 NaOH 共热，产物硬脂酸钠是肥皂主要成分，另一产物丙三醇即甘油。
detailEn: Tristearin with NaOH gives sodium stearate (the main soap component) and glycerol.

subs.name: 氨
subs.note: 化肥工业之母；反应可逆。
subs.noteEn: The backbone of fertilizer making; the reaction is reversible.

oneLiner: 氮气与氢气在高温高压、催化剂下可逆化合生成氨。
oneLinerEn: N₂ and H₂ combine reversibly under high pressure, heat and catalyst.
detail: 哈伯法合成氨为化肥工业奠基，是 20 世纪最重要的化学工艺之一。反应可逆，正反应放热、气体分子数减小。
detailEn: The Haber process underpins fertilizer making; the reaction is reversible, exothermic and reduces gas moles.

subs.name: 氯气
subs.note: 阳极产物，与 NaOH 反应制漂白液。
subs.noteEn: Anode product; with NaOH makes bleach.

oneLiner: 电解饱和食盐水制取烧碱、氢气和氯气。
oneLinerEn: Electrolysis of brine yields caustic soda, H₂ and Cl₂.
detail: 氯碱工业基础反应；阳极出 Cl₂、阴极出 H₂ 与 NaOH。Cl₂ 与 NaOH 反应即得漂白液。
detailEn: The core chlor-alkali reaction: Cl₂ at the anode, H₂ and NaOH at the cathode; Cl₂ with NaOH makes bleach.

subs.name: 氯气
subs.note: 与石灰乳反应制漂白粉。
subs.noteEn: Reacted with lime milk to make bleaching powder.

subs.name: 次氯酸钙
subs.noteEn: The active component of bleaching powder.

subs.name: 二氧化碳（空气）
subs.note: 与次氯酸钙反应导致失效。

subs.name: 次氯酸
subs.note: 强氧化性，起漂白作用，也因此失效。
subs.noteEn: Strong oxidizer; does the bleaching and hence the spoilage.

oneLiner: 氯气与石灰乳制漂白粉，失效是因与空气中 CO₂ 反应生成 HClO。
oneLinerEn: Cl₂ with lime makes bleaching powder; it spoils by reacting with CO₂ to give HClO.
detail: 有效成分 Ca(ClO)₂；接触空气与水生成强氧化性 HClO 而漂白，也随之失效。
detailEn: Active Ca(ClO)₂ forms oxidizing HClO with air and water — the basis of bleaching and of spoilage.

subs.name: 氧化铁（铁矿石主要成分）

oneLiner: 一氧化碳在高温下把氧化铁还原为铁。
oneLinerEn: CO reduces iron oxide to iron at high temperature.
detail: 高炉中以 CO 作还原剂炼铁，是现代钢铁工业的核心反应。
detailEn: CO serves as the reducing agent — the heart of modern ironmaking.

subs.name: 铝粉
subs.note: 强还原剂，反应放出大量热。
subs.noteEn: Strong reducer; the reaction releases intense heat.

subs.name: 铁（熔融态）
subs.note: 高温熔化流出，用于野外焊接钢轨。
subs.noteEn: Molten iron runs out; used to weld rails on site.

oneLiner: 铝与氧化铁高温反应，置换出铁并放出大量热。
oneLinerEn: Aluminum reduces iron oxide, yielding molten iron with intense heat.
detail: 利用铝的强还原性与反应放热，产生高温熔融铁，用于野外焊接钢轨。
detailEn: Aluminum's strong reducing power and the exothermicity give molten iron, used to weld rails on site.

subs.name: 金（镀金引脚、金手指、触点）
subs.note: 空气中不氧化、也不溶于弱酸，只溶于强氧化—配位体系。
subs.noteEn: Neither tarnishes in air nor dissolves in weak acids; needs an oxidizing complexing medium.

subs.name: 浓硝酸
subs.note: 氧化剂，把 Au 氧化为 Au(III)。
subs.noteEn: The oxidizer, raising Au to Au(III).

subs.name: 浓盐酸
subs.note: 提供 Cl⁻ 配体，稳定 [AuCl₄]⁻，使溶解得以持续。
subs.noteEn: Supplies Cl⁻ ligands that stabilize [AuCl₄]⁻, driving dissolution on.

subs.name: 氯金酸
subs.note: 金进入溶液的形态，橙黄色，蒸干会分解。
subs.noteEn: Dissolved gold, orange-yellow; decomposes on evaporation to dryness.

subs.name: 一氧化氮
subs.note: 遇空气即变红棕色 NO₂，须在通风橱内尾气吸收。
subs.noteEn: Turns red-brown NO₂ in air; scrub it in a fume hood.

subs.name: 焦亚硫酸钠
subs.note: 还原剂，S(+4) 被氧化为 S(+6)，把金沉回单质。
subs.noteEn: Reducer; S(+4) to S(+6) drops gold back to the metal.

subs.name: 金粉（棕色沉淀）
subs.note: 沉出的粗金，须再熔炼或电解提纯才能得高纯金。
subs.noteEn: Crude precipitate; smelting or electrolytic refining follows.

subs.name: 硼砂（助熔剂）
subs.note: 熔炼时造渣，带走铜、铁等残余杂质。
subs.noteEn: Forms a slag in the melt, carrying off residual copper and iron.

term: 电子废弃物提金（城市矿山）
oneLiner: 富集镀金引脚与触点，用王水或氰化物溶出金，再还原沉出金粉、熔炼成锭。
oneLinerEn: Concentrate gold-plated pins and contacts, dissolve the Au in aqua regia or cyanide, precipitate it and smelt a button.
detail: 流程四步：拆解分选（取下 CPU 引脚、内存金手指、继电器触点，破碎后以磁选和涡电流富集）→ 浸出（把单质金转成可溶配合物）→ 还原沉淀（得棕色金粉）→ 酸洗烘干，配硼砂助熔在 1100 ℃ 以上熔炼铸锭；电解精炼可再提纯至 99.99%。品位上，一吨废旧电路板约含 80–300 g 金，天然金矿常只有 1–5 g/t，故称「城市矿山」。但金只是微米级镀层，且多为铜、银、钯综合回收的副产品，家庭「土法炼金」既危险又不划算：王水放出 NO₂ 与 Cl₂，氰化物微量即可致命，酸性废液会长期污染土壤与地下水，正规工厂须做尾气吸收与废液中和。
detailEn: Four steps: sorting (pull gold-plated CPU pins, memory edge fingers and relay contacts, crush, then concentrate magnetically and by eddy current) → leaching (convert metallic Au into a soluble complex) → reduction (brown gold powder precipitates) → acid-wash, dry and smelt above 1100 °C with borax flux to cast a button; electrolytic refining lifts purity to 99.99%. By grade a tonne of scrap circuit boards holds some 80–300 g of gold against 1–5 g/t in natural ore — hence 'urban mine'. Yet the gold is only a micrometre-scale plating and usually a by-product of recovering copper, silver and palladium, so backyard refining is both hazardous and uneconomic: aqua regia releases NO₂ and Cl₂, cyanide is lethal in traces, and acidic effluent poisons soil and groundwater for decades. Licensed plants scrub the off-gas and neutralize the liquor.

subs.name: 浓硫酸
subs.note: 催化剂兼吸水剂，促进平衡右移。
subs.noteEn: Catalyst and water absorber, shifting equilibrium right.

subs.name: 乙酸乙酯
subs.note: 有香味的酯，酒香/香精来源。
subs.noteEn: Fragrant ester; source of fruity aromas.

oneLiner: 乙酸与乙醇在浓硫酸催化下生成有香味的乙酸乙酯。
oneLinerEn: Acetic acid and ethanol form fragrant ethyl acetate, catalyzed by conc. H₂SO₄.
detail: 酸脱羟基、醇脱氢；浓硫酸作催化剂与吸水剂。酒的陈香、食醋风味部分源于酯类。
detailEn: The acid loses –OH and the alcohol –H; conc. H₂SO₄ catalyzes and absorbs water. Esters contribute to aged-wine and vinegar aromas.

subs.name: 乙醛
subs.note: 氧化产物，有刺激性气味。

oneLiner: 乙醇在铜催化并加热下被氧化为乙醛。
oneLinerEn: Ethanol is oxidized to acetaldehyde over copper with heating.
detail: 铜丝作催化剂，是酒精在体内代谢、呼气酒精检测的化学原理之一。
detailEn: Copper catalyzes this — related to how alcohol metabolizes and to breathalyzer chemistry.

subs.name: 水
subs.noteEn: Photolysed to supply hydrogen and release oxygen.

subs.name: 氧气
subs.noteEn: The main source of Earth's oxygen.

oneLiner: 绿色植物在光照与叶绿体下把 CO₂ 和水合成葡萄糖并放氧。
oneLinerEn: Plants build glucose from CO₂ and water using light in chloroplasts, releasing O₂.
detail: 地球氧气与有机物之源，维持碳—氧平衡，把太阳能转化为化学能。
detailEn: The source of Earth's oxygen and organic matter; it balances the carbon cycle and stores solar energy.

oneLiner: 葡萄糖在酒化酶作用下分解为乙醇和二氧化碳。
oneLinerEn: Glucose breaks into ethanol and CO₂ under the action of zymase.
detail: 酿酒的核心反应；产生的 CO₂ 也是馒头、面包膨松的原因之一。
detailEn: Key to brewing; the CO₂ also leavens bread and steamed buns.

subs.name: 氢氧化铝
subs.note: 胃药（胃舒平）有效成分，中和胃酸。

subs.name: 碳酸氢钠（小苏打）
subs.note: 也可中和胃酸，但会产气。
subs.noteEn: Also neutralizes acid but releases gas.

subs.name: 二氧化碳
subs.note: 小苏打中和时产生，易腹胀者慎用。
subs.noteEn: Given off by baking soda; can cause bloating.

oneLiner: 氢氧化铝（或碳酸氢钠）中和过多的胃酸。
oneLinerEn: Aluminum hydroxide (or NaHCO₃) neutralizes excess stomach acid.
detail: 胃酸主要成分是盐酸；含 Al(OH)₃ 的胃舒平通过中和缓解胃痛。小苏打也可中和但会产气。
detailEn: Stomach acid is HCl; Al(OH)₃ antacids relieve pain by neutralization. Baking soda also works but releases gas.
